orders: Review the patient's current medication list for dopamine receptor blocking agents (e.g., antipsychotics, metoclopramide) or other drugs known to cause dystonia
Perform a detailed neurological examination assessing for signs of parkinsonism (resting tremor, bradykinesia, rigidity) and cerebellar dysfunction
Order an MRI of the brain with attention to the basal ganglia

dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Idiopathic adult-onset focal dystonia (specifically foot dystonia)
Alternative 1: Hereditary dystonia (e.g., DYT1 or other genetic forms presenting in adulthood)
Alternative 2: Functional neurological disorder (psychogenic gait/dystonia)
